source_organization: Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC), Open Data Portal
target_semantics: Daily water consumption by area for isolated months, not continuous multi-year daily series
reason: PMC open data contains daily water consumption for only December 2016 and December 2017 (2 isolated months). The PMC Water Supply Department portal (water.punecorporation.org) has real-time sensor data but requires authenticated access and does not expose a downloadable multi-year daily dataset. The existing validated ML methodology requires a continuous daily time-series spanning multiple years. Two isolated months of daily data are insufficient for chronological train/test splitting, time-series cross-validation, or seasonal pattern learning.
